important_limitations: No verified district-level PLFS occupation-by-industry microdata was available without restricted microdata registration/download.
District ITI seats were not directly verified; real DGT/DITE division totals are allocated within division to districts using a transparent Udyam-employment share proxy.
Occupation mix and course-to-NCO mapping are analyst priors, not observed district data.
Udyam employment is a registered-enterprise employment proxy, not a complete district employment census.
